d: Yavnon dvara aambhi naresh ko naya chhatrap niyukt karne ke nirnay se kekaiy naresh asantusht hain, unka kahna hai ki vo ye kadapi svikar nahin karenge ki koee paradhin vyakti unhen aadesh den. kya kekaiy naresh ki ye asantushti takshashila aur kekaiy men aur matbhed paida karegi ya aachary vishnugupt koee any marg nikalenge ....kya hota hai dekhie is bhag men
